sources: recreation.gov campsite catalog for facility 233610 (trip_data/ridb_campsites.json, fetched 2026-10-20)

values.note: 'Rudd's Creek Campground is open April 1 - October 31. The Day Use Park, located across Hwy 58, is open year-around.'

season.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233610 (Overview: 'Rudd's Creek Campground is open April 1 - October 31'; gate house notice '01 April - 31 October'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 2026 Peak Season (Apr 1 - Oct 31): standard non-electric $24, standard electric/water $34; double sites $48 / $68.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233610/rates (Peak Season 2026-04-01 to 2026-10-31: STANDARD NONELECTRIC 24, STANDARD ELECTRIC 34, double-unit variants 48 / 68), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233610 ('All electric sites have water hook-ups') + campsite catalog (all 72 public STANDARD ELECTRIC sites list Electricity Hookup 50, Water Hookup Yes; sewer only at a management site), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 96 public sites (72 electric/water, 24 non-electric) on gravel pads; RV lengths 20-45 ft, mostly 35-45; three pull-throughs, the rest back-in. Rec.gov's description says 98 sites.

sites.source: recreation.gov campsite catalog for 233610 (96 STANDARD sites + 3 MANAGEMENT; Max Vehicle Length to 45; 3 Pull-through) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233610 ('There are 98 sites for tents or RVs', 'All campsites have gravel bases'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Swimming beach, picnic shelter, and a campers-only boat ramp and courtesy dock.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233610 ('hot showers, flush toilets and a dump station', 'its own boat ramp and courtesty dock for campers only'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: All 96 public sites are reservable on recreation.gov. 'Maximum stay is 14-days within any 30 day period.' One campsite held per customer at a time. Check-in 4 pm, check-out 2 pm; no check-in after the gatehouse closes (9 pm). Alcohol and golf carts/off-road vehicles prohibited.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233610 (facility_rules maxStay 14 nights 'Rolling 30 Days', maxConcurrentStay 1; notices on check-in, gatehouse hours 9 a.m.-9 p.m., alcohol) + campsite catalog (all 96 STANDARD sites reservable), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 'Golden Age/Access and America the Beautiful Interagency Senior and Access Passes are accepted at this campground and cardholders receive a 50% discount on camping fees.' Cardholder must be present and camp the whole stay.

summary: Confirmed $24-$34 (2026), 50-amp electric with water on rec.gov. Added season Apr 1 - Oct 31, 96 sites to 45 ft (3 pull-through), showers/flush toilets/dump, all reservable, 14 nights in 30, Senior/Access 50%. Not stated: booking window (left inherited); rec.gov carries a militaryDiscount rule flag with no description, not recorded.
